test_title: PYST 35: RRB Group D - Mathematics (Held On: 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A camp has provisions for 55 persons for 14 days. In how many days will the same provisions finish off, if the strength of the camp is increased to 70 persons?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total provisions remain constant, so we can directly apply the inverse proportion relation M₁D₁ = M₂D₂.

⇒ 55 × 14 = 70 × D₂

⇒ D₂ = 770 ÷ 70 = 11

**∴ The correct answer is 11 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial strength of the camp (M₁) = 55 persons

Initial number of days provisions last (D₁) = 14 days

New strength of the camp (M₂) = 70 persons

**Formula Used:**

M₁ × D₁ = M₂ × D₂

 Scenario 1 55 Persons, 14 Days Scenario 2 70 Persons, D Days 
• 
• 
• 55 × 14 = 70 × D 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total provisions required = 55 × 14 = 770 man-days

⇒ Let the provisions last for D₂ days for the 70 persons.

⇒ 70 × D₂ = 770

⇒ D₂ = 770 ÷ 70

⇒ D₂ = 11

**∴ The correct answer is 11 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Chain Rule (MDH Concept)

For constant work or fixed quantity of provisions, the relationship is M₁ × D₁ × H₁ = M₂ × D₂ × H₂, where M is the number of persons, D is days, and H is hours per day.

Inverse Proportion

When the number of consumers increases, the time for which a given quantity of provision lasts decreases proportionally. Thus, Men × Days = Constant Value.

Provisions After Some Days

If after 'x' days some people leave or join the camp, the equation becomes M₁ × (D₁ − x) = M₂ × Dₙₑw applied strictly to the remaining provisions.
